# Design Polish Checklist

Polish in this order:

1. Header and action clarity
   - Tighten title, subtitle, and action alignment
   - Reduce redundant intro copy
2. Spacing rhythm
   - Create clearer separation between major sections
   - Reduce mechanical repeated padding
   - Expand overly narrow content frames when the page is primarily dashboard, list, or management UI
3. Surface quality
   - Normalize card, paper, and toolbar treatment
   - Remove unnecessary nested containers
4. Scanability
   - Improve status chips, emphasis, row actions, and summary labels
   - Make dense data easier to skim
5. States
   - Make loading, empty, and error states feel intentional and on-brand
6. Final restraint check
   - Remove decorative styling that does not improve comprehension
